method.sourceReview: Original PDF freshly rendered and viewed; source-0 legend and both original JPEGs viewed independently of prior coordinates. All 55 legend labels checked individually.
method.anchorReview: Original-image coordinate rulers, local enlargement and per-item contact sheets; blue cross = numeral, red ring = old pin, green ring = retained/corrected pin. Each of 71 output windows inspected.
method.coordinateFormula: x=100*(pixelX-left)/cropWidth; y=100*(pixelY-top)/cropHeight; up to 4 decimal places. Anchor tolerance is visual measurement uncertainty, not accuracy added by rounding.
method.clinicalScope: Transcription and graphical localization only; no qualified clinical or educational approval.
method.limits: JPEG blur is not improved by enlargement. Integer anchor pixels are visual estimates (±2 px, ±3 px on four small targets); rounded percentages do not imply subpixel source accuracy.
